case_number: 2023 INSC 618; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3856/2022; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4529/2022; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4525/2022; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4581/2022
summary: Environmental non-compliance appeal; NGT's directions on fly ash management upheld; Mission formation for remediation including MoEF&CC/Coal/Power Secretaries; legacy fly ash utilization roadmap; compensation increased for 2020 incident victims; statutory regulators enforcement duty; natural justice challenge rejected; NGT's procedural compliance affirmed; violations liability maintained.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; NGT order of 18.01.2022 upheld; respondents held liable for past violations; compensation for deceased heirs confirmed at Rs. 15 lakhs.
